title: mem ask --json
description: The question that is now waiting. `mem ask` never blocks.

project.description: The project the question was written in, or null outside one. Over the remote it is the one the server picked, which the asking machine's local hub shows.

recommend.description: The answer the asker would pick, or null when none was given.

audience.description: Who the question went to: `orchestrator` or `saiful` when --for said so, null for any person's.
